title: 01 / Meet the people
text: Welcome to Between, a dating laboratory with twenty five entirely fictional people. Each has two authored source profiles and a personal agent. The experiment runs all three hundred unique pairings, giving every person twenty four ranked connections. Start with the people, not the scores. You can browse by city or search for a shared interest.

title: 02 / Two sources become one agent
text: Here is the complete input flow. Add a person, paste their LinkedIn and public Instagram fixture links, and read the sources. These example addresses identify fictional documents, not real social accounts. The analysis opens a profile first. Maya values curiosity, kindness, and independence. Her hobbies, needs, and relationship intention come from explicit source statements.

title: 03 / Every claim has evidence
text: Nothing is hidden behind a personality label. Open the LinkedIn fixture to inspect the original document, then the Instagram fixture to read Maya's interests and needs. Each extracted statement keeps its source. Missing information stays unknown. The agent represents what the person actually said, rather than guessing romantic needs from a career or a photograph.

title: 04 / Watch the agents date
text: Now Maya's agent meets Leo's at a neighborhood cafe. The first turn identifies shared interests. Leo's agent responds with a stated need and asks about social time. Maya's agent adapts and proposes a schedule. Leo responds to that proposal. Finally, the agents check their relationship intentions directly. You can pause, step through, or open the explanation behind any turn.

title: 05 / Disagreement is part of the date
text: A different pairing produces a different conversation. Samir prefers quiet, predictable plans. Inez prefers a spontaneous, social afternoon. Their agents negotiate a fixed start time with an optional group activity. But Samir wants commitment and Inez is exploring. The harness preserves that disagreement. It caps the score instead of pretending a clever compromise resolves different intentions.

title: 06 / Rankings you can inspect
text: Only after the profiles and conversations do we compare connections. Every person receives a ranking from their own perspective. Open Why this fit to inspect values, interests, intentions, rhythm, social energy, and negotiation. Different cities are flagged. These are transparent heuristic scores, not probabilities of relationship success. You can switch people and replay any pairing.

title: 07 / Add a character and keep the experiment
text: The demo is also editable. Supply two new fictional source documents using the labeled format, and the app creates a new agent and recalculates all pairings. Custom characters stay in this browser. Export downloads the sources, analyses, conversations, and rankings together. The default twenty five person experiment is always available without entering anything.

title: Between / A little more connection
text: Between uses an inspectable, rule based agent harness. No language model or live social scraper is claimed. It is a complete fictional simulation: two sources, an evidence backed profile, visible agent dates, and personalized rankings. The website works without API keys. A little less swiping. A little more connection.
